links.outcome: Principal diagnosis matching against postnatal-confirmed diagnosis for LLM differential diagnoses
links.effect: Principal diagnosis matching: DeepSeek 66/85 (77.6%), Gemini 59/85 (69.4%), ChatGPT 52/85 (61.2%); Cochran's Q = 6.2553, P = .0438; no pairwise difference significant after Holm correction.
links.quote: DeepSeek achieved the highest principal diagnosis matching rate (66/85, 77.6%), followed by Gemini (59/85, 69.4%) and ChatGPT (52/85, 61.2%).

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the diagnostic reasoning, accuracy, and safety of several commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek) on retrospective text summaries of fetal MRI cases.
